min_standing_note.value: Minimum 2.0/4.0 GPA for undergraduate students and 3.0/4.0 for graduate students (individual departments may enforce higher thresholds); in-person course enrollment at the Kent Campus required.
min_standing_note.notes: In-person Kent Campus requirement stated on #page=2.

min_gpa_host.notes: 2.0 out of 4.0 scale for undergraduate exchange students; 3.0 out of 4.0 scale for graduate exchange students.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Undergraduate baseline: TOEFL iBT 71, IELTS Academic 6.0, Duolingo 100, or PTE Academic 48. Graduate baseline: TOEFL iBT 71 / IELTS 6.0 (specific programs may require higher). RHET 1020 waiver not stated.

fall_term_dates.notes: Fall Break Oct 8–11, 2026; Thanksgiving Break Nov 25–29, 2026.

tuition_model.notes: Tuition is waived per exchange agreement within standard credit limits (12–18 UG / 8–18 GR); credits above maximum are billed per credit hour.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived as $9,147.50 / 5 months = $1,829.50/month (rounded to $1,830) from KSU's AY 2026-2027 1-semester exchange DS-2019 financial proof / living cost estimate ($9,147.50 for 1 semester; $18,295 for 2 semesters).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: Official AY 2026-2027 1-semester exchange living cost / DS-2019 financial support estimate ($9,147.50 USD for 1 semester; $18,295 USD for 2 semesters), already denominated in USD (recorded 2026-11-15).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: KSU Student Health Insurance Plan (UHCSR SHIP) is mandatory for all international exchange students and cannot be waived. Mandatory fees: $20/sem international activity fee, $100 first-semester orientation fee, plus UG fees ($15/sem arts, $93.84/sem career services, $90/sem student health); $10/transcript fee.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: Career services ($93.84), student health ($90), and transcript ($10) fees detailed on #page=3; SHIP portal at https://www.kent.edu/deweese/student-health-insurance-plan-ship.

housing_availability.notes: University residence halls and meal plans available for exchange students (apply post-admission); break/early arrival housing $35/night on #page=3.

housing_notes.value: 2026-2027 double residence hall rate approx. $4,335/semester (https://www.kent.edu/housing/room-rates); recommended Blue Meal Plan $5,690/year (~$2,845/sem per https://www.kent.edu/dining/meal-plans); seasonal break housing $35/night (`KSU Fact Sheet 2026-2027.pdf#page=3`).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 Exchange Visitor visa (Form DS-2019) required for non-US students; 2026-2027 proof of financial support for exchange students is $9,147.50 USD (1 semester) or $18,295 USD (2 semesters).

english_course_list_url.notes: Instruction is in English across the main course catalog; live term schedule requires portal filtering at https://keys.kent.edu/ePROD/bwlkffcs.p_adv_unsecure_sel_crse_search.

credit_system_and_load.value: US credit hours: UG 12–18 credits/semester; GR 8–18 credits/semester. Excess credits beyond 18 incur standard per-credit tuition charges.

course_restrictions_note.value: Students must enroll in in-person courses at the Kent Campus; some programs and courses are not available to international exchange students or at the Kent Campus.

city_tier.notes: Flagship Kent Campus sits in Kent, Ohio (~28,000 residents per kent.edu); left unknown rather than assuming city_tier label.

international_support_services.value: Office of Global Education orientation, J-1 visa support, housing/dining coordination, and DeWeese Health Center.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall Semester or Academic Year: nomination March 1, application April 1. Spring Semester: nomination October 1, application October 15 (KSU Florence deadlines earlier: Sep 15 / Oct 1).
